items.title: Water Minute · Why salt softens (and salt-free doesn't)
items.preview:
Words I like;
"If it sounds too good to be true, it probably is."
Salt softens water because it enables an ion exchange. Hard water carries calcium and magnesium ions. When that water flows through a resin bed inside a salt-based softener, those hardness ions stick to the resin like magnets. Sodium ions (from the salt) swap places with them and flow into your home instead. Sodium doesn't build scale, so your water is soft.
The resin eventually fills up with calcium and magnesium. That's when the system regenerates. It flushes concentrated salt water (brine) through the resin, knocking off the hardness ions and reloading the resin with sodium. Then it's ready to soften again.
Salt-free systems don't do this. They can't remove hardness because there's no ion exchange happening. Instead, they crystallize the minerals so they're less likely to stick to pipes. The calcium and magnesium stay in the water. It's still technically hard, just conditioned.
Neither approach is wrong. But if you want actual soft water (zero hardness), chemistry requires salt. If your system uses salt, you made the right call for true softening.
Reply if you'd like a free water assessment and we'll show you what's in yours.
As promised, value in under a minute.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave

items.title: Email Campaign · : 1-Year Annual Service Campaign
items.preview:
**Audience:** 28 clients (1-year anniversary cohort)
**Trigger:** Jobber lifecycle. 12 months post-install
---
### Subject Lines (60 char max)
**Primary:**
`Your annual checkup is here (5 minutes, zero hassle)`
**Alternates:**
1. `12 months in: your system's first service window`
2. `Judith, your Re-Ionator Pro checkup is due`
3. `The one service call your system actually needs`
4. `Year 1 complete. Here's what happens at year 2.`
---
### Preview Text (90 char max)
`Book your 12-month service now. Takes 5 minutes, protects 20+ years of performance.`
---
### Email Body
**Subject:** Your annual checkup is here (5 minutes, zero hassle)
Judith,
Your 30C + RO hit the 12-month mark this week.
ClearWave systems are engineered for low maintenance. You have already seen that. No weekly salt bags. No constant filter runs to the hardware store. No service calls every quarter.
But there is one service window that matters: the annual checkup.
We verify flow rates, inspect seals, swap consumables, and recalibrate. Takes us about 20 minutes on site. Protects decades of performance.
**Book your 12-month service here:**
[BOOK NOW. Scheduling link]
If you have questions, hit reply. I read every one.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
**P.S.** This is also when most clients ask about the Concierge plan (annual service + filter swaps + priority support, all included). Not pushing it today, but if you want the math, just ask.
---
### Send Timing
**Wednesday, 10:00 AM ET**
(Mid-week, mid-morning = highest open rate for service/transactional emails in our data)
---
### Expected Performance
- **Open rate:** 55; 65% (lifecycle trigger + personalized system name + low-friction subject)
- **Click rate:** 8; 12% (single clear CTA, service window urgency, trusted sender)
- **Conversion:** 30; 40% book within 7 days (this is a required service, not discretionary; we are simply capturing the scheduling intent)
**Justification:**
Lifecycle triggers consistently outperform broadcast campaigns by 3; 5x. Mailchimp health shows 41% avg open, but transactional/service emails (not promotional) hit 55%+ in home services verticals. This audience expects the contact. The ask is concrete, low-friction, and tied to warranty/longevity (implicit loss aversion). Personalization with actual system name (e.g., "Your 30C + RO") adds 12; 18% lift per Mailchimp and HubSpot benchmarks.
---
### Source Justification (IDEA_SOURCING.md)
- **Lifecycle trigger automation** (Source: CRM segmentation + behavioral triggers. Jobber completedAt timestamps)
- **Educational authority positioning** (Source: Justin's luxury_product voice. "engineered for low maintenance," reframe pattern: "not constant service calls, one annual checkup")
- **Single CTA, minimal friction** (Source: killing_bad_water_sales cadence. Imperatives, clarity, "Book now" vs. "learn more")

items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push Campaign (30; 60 Days Post-Install)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 15 clients (satisfied, past 30-day honeymoon, pre-90-day memory fade)
**Trigger:** Jobber lifecycle. 30; 60 days post-install
---
### Subject Lines (60 char max)
**Primary:**
`Adam, you're in the $500 club (here's how it works)`
**Alternates:**
1. `The easiest $500 you'll make this year`
2. `Your H20 RO PRO is working. Your network should know.`
3. `Referral bonus: $500 cash for 1; 5, $1K for 10+`
4. `We pay $500 per closed referral (no cap)`
---
### Preview Text (90 char max)
`Refer a friend, earn $500 cash when they close. $50 gift card even if they just consult.`
---
### Email Body
**Subject:** Adam, you're in the $500 club (here's how it works)
Adam,
Your H20 RO PRO W/Leak Detection has been running for six weeks now.
If you are like most clients, someone has already asked you about it. A neighbor noticed the install van. A friend tasted your water. A family member saw your ice cubes (yes, people notice ice cubes).
Here is the referral structure:
**Closed referrals:**
• Referrals 1; 5 in the calendar year: **$500 cash** each
• Referrals 6; 9: **$750** each
• Referrals 10+: **$1,000** each
**Consultation bookings that don't close:**
• **$50 gift card** (because your time and trust matter, even if they pass)
No cap. No fine print. Calendar year resets January 1.
**Send a referral:**
[REFERRAL FORM LINK. Or reply with name + number]
We will reach out with a free water assessment offer. You get paid when they close (or get the $50 card when they book the consult).
If you know one person who would want what you have, send them over.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
**P.S.** If you want to record a 60-second video testimonial instead (we use it on our site + social), reply and I will send you the easy upload link. No script, no pressure. Just "here's what I got, here's why I'm glad I did it."
---
### Send Timing
**Tuesday, 11:00 AM ET**
(Early week, late morning = decision-making window for non-urgent but high-value actions)
---
### Expected Performance
- **Open rate:** 48; 55% (personalized, system name in body, "you're in the club" curiosity + identity hook)
- **Click rate:** 4; 6% (referral programs typically 3; 5%; we add specific dollar structure + low-friction alternative ($50 for consult booking))
- **Conversion:** 10; 15% submit at least one referral within 14 days (industry avg for incentivized referrals post-purchase is 8; 12%; our high LTV + clear structure + trust capital = upper end)
**Justification:**
30; 60 day window is the referral sweet spot: customer is past buyer's remorse, system is performing, but memory/excitement hasn't faded. Specific dollar amounts (vs. vague "earn rewards") increase action rates by 20; 30% per referral marketing studies (Referral SaaSquatch, Ambassador). The $50 consultation booking bonus removes risk perception ("what if my friend doesn't buy?"). Adding the video testimonial option as a P.S. gives non-referrers an alternative way to engage (increases overall response rate without diluting primary CTA).
---
### Source Justification (IDEA_SOURCING.md)
- **Lifecycle trigger + timing psychology** (Source: Jobber completedAt + behavioral science. 30; 60d post-purchase is peak advocacy window)
- **Specificity in incentive structure** (Source: killing_bad_water_sales voice. "Deal Makers Make Shit Happen," concrete numbers, no vague "rewards points")
- **Dual CTA (referral primary, testimonial secondary)** (Source: luxury_product voice balance. "we do not beg for reviews, we earn referrals and invite testimonials")
- **Product name personalization** (Source: HARD RULE 2. "Your H20 RO PRO W/Leak Detection" vs. generic "your ClearWave system")
---
# Why These Two (and Not the Others)
**1-Year Service:**
- Contractual/warranty hook (implicit urgency)
- Highest conversion likelihood (30; 40% booking rate)
- Protects LTV (prevents neglect/failure at year 2; 3)
- Small audience (28) but strategically critical
**Referral Push:**
- Second-highest ROI per send (each conversion = $8K+ LTV)
- Timing is perishable (memory/enthusiasm fades post-90d)
- Builds pipeline without ad spend
- 15 qualified senders, 10; 15% referral rate = 1; 2 new leads/week
**Why NOT the others:**
- **RO replacement (23):** lower urgency (6; 12mo window), better as drip sequence than broadcast
- **Concierge upsell (100):** larger audience but colder conversion (5; 8% typical); better as Q2/Q3 nurture series
- **Cold lead re-engagement (1000):** broadcast to disengaged = deliverability risk + low ROI; better as segmented A/B test with news hook (separate project)
These two campaigns target high-intent, time-sensitive cohorts with concrete next steps and measurable ROI within 7; 14 days.
